abilities.name: Time Walk
description: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last 2 seconds. Cast range: 650 / 700 / 750 / 800. Damage reversal time: 2. Cooldown: 21 / 17 / 13 / 9. Mana cost: 40.

abilities.name: Time Dilation
description: Applies a temporal field to nearby enemies, extending their ability cooldowns by 7 8 9 10 sec. Each affected ability slows movement by -7 -8 -9 -10% and attack speed by -7 -8 -9 -10, while dealing damage per second. Radius: 775. Duration: 7 / 8 / 9 / 10. Slow per ability: -7% / -8% / -9% / -10%. Cooldown extension: 30% / 40% / 50% / 60%. Damage per second per ability: 7 / 9 / 11 / 13. Cooldown: 28 / 24 / 20 / 16. Mana cost: 90.

abilities.name: Time Lock
description: Adds the chance for an attack to lock an enemy unit in time while attacking it a second time. Duration: 0.5. Chance: 10% / 12% / 14% / 16%. Bonus damage: 18 / 22 / 26 / 30.

abilities.name: Chronosphere
description: Creates a blister in spacetime, trapping all units caught in its sphere of influence and causes you to move very quickly inside it. Only Faceless Void and any units he controls are unaffected. Invisible enemies in the sphere will be revealed. Radius: 500. Duration: 2.5. Cooldown: 140 / 130 / 120. Cast range: 500. Mana cost: 125.
